gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's Black Friday prices for the whole shortlist: Keychron's own store sells the K3 Max from $72.49 (list $109.99, and $15 under the $87.49 ChatGPT's card showed), with the K3 HE at $95.99 and K3 Ultra 8K at $98.99 as the replacements its page names, and Logitech sells the MX Mechanical Mini at $129.99 (list $159.99).
standout_why: Compared against mechkeyfoundry.com (both pages, cited), mkbguide.com, pcreviewer.org, zelobiz.com and pickedtech.com. mechkeyfoundry gives only list prices checked 14 Oct 2026 (K3 Max $109.99, Air75 V3 $139.95, Flow 2 84 $159.00, MX Mechanical Mini $159.99). mkbguide and pcreviewer print no dollar prices, zelobiz prints two ('$119+', '$149+'), and pickedtech prints list prices. None carries a November sale price. The supersession half is not new: mkbguide already says the K3 Ultra 8K supersedes the K3 Max, so only the dated prices stand out, and they expire with the sales. The cited RTINGS list returned only navigation to my fetch, so I could not compare against its body.
decides: It confirms the K3 Max as the value pick for programming rather than changing it: QMK remapping with 2.4 GHz from $72.49 at Keychron is the lowest price I read today for a tri-mode QMK low-profile 75%. The $72.49 is the store-search price and I could not read which variant it belongs to; Keychron says hot-swap is on the RGB hot-swappable version only, so ChatGPT's $87.49 may be that variant (my inference, not read). Among the boards we link, the brief's partner read puts the Lofree Flow 2 84 at $127.20 at checkout (page $159.00), below the $139.95 Amazon listing for the NuPhy Air75 V3; the Flow 2 remaps in VIA (mkbguide, mechkeyfoundry) while the Air75 V3 uses NuPhyIO, so the Flow 2 honestly wins the 'aluminum, VIA' segment. That price order is not settled: a second Amazon Air75 V3 listing reads $111.96, and nuphy.com refused every request, so the page should not claim the Flow 2 undercuts the Air75 V3 without re-reading NuPhy's store. I did not re-open the Lofree pages (HTTP 429); those figures are the brief's. Where each loses: K3 Max on battery (1,550 mAh, 73 h) and on Keychron itself pointing to newer models; K3 Ultra 8K on ZMK instead of QMK; K3 HE on 55 h battery; Air75 V3 on no QMK/VIA; MX Mechanical Mini on Options+ only and no hot-swap; Flow 2 84 on price and about 17 h backlit battery; original Flow84 on no 2.4 GHz and limited remapping; K1 Max could not be priced at Keychron.
